name: Unified Recruitment Platform
notes: One Docker container: apps/ai serves /api and the built apps/web (STATIC_DIR). Bundle = apps/ai/Dockerfile at the root, apps/ai as server/, apps/web/dist as public/. GEMINI_API_KEY is in the project env (not here). Guest-created; updates use the key in ~/.config/ued-launchpad/keys/<id>.
